_deferred_kinds_note: Parts the frame model does not carry: connections (welds, bolts, clips, hangers, hold-downs, straps) and reinforcing. They reach the sheets as detail callouts, notes, plan symbols and takeoff rows. A work item of one of them is listed on the plan as deferred and built by nothing. Both names are Blueprint's proposal, not reviewed, and NOT in the app's vocabulary today.

2d._status: DRAFT 2026-11-20. This process has NO 2D drawing step of ours: the engineer's set IS the 2D (Blueprint's assumption, not reviewed: ASSUMPTIONS.md 2). The section exists in the shape of PACK V1 so that the compiler answers "switched off" and so that no section of the board waits for a drawing. NOT RUN, and no tool draws what it describes.
2d._enabled_note: THE 2D SWITCH. false (as shipped) = no 2D work order is compiled, the 3D compile waits for no drawing, and a work item of the kinds below is placed by the procedure of its phase (position from the designer's model, size from the engineer's set), written down in numbers before anything is placed. true = one frame pre-plan drawing per section would be drawn and approved by a person before anything is built (Michael, blueprint-michael 2026-11-18 22:59Z: "we should be putting just a line on cross sections first, right? all outside of revit"). NOT SUPPORTED today: no tool draws it; do not switch it on.

2d._kinds_note: The kinds a pre-plan would draw. With the switch off, a work item of one of them is not "to be found by scan": its phase places it by its page, and the plan says how many.
2d.gate: none: no rule of the outline rulebook is about framing. A person would approve each pre-plan.

defaults.note: As PACK V1 lists them; this pack uses none (defaults_scope is empty in every phase). The defaults of this process are the lines of standards/ENGINEERING_FRAME_RUNBOOK.md section 5, used without asking and stated in the phase note.

_sheet_switch_note: THE SHEET SWITCH is ONE field: phases[id=E9].standard_items[id=si-sheets-ask].params.ask.default. "yes" (as shipped) = the sheet phases SH1, SH2, SH4, SH7, SH8 are compiled after the frame audit. "no" = they are left out and nothing else changes. A person can also answer the slot sheet_set for one project (--answers).
_kinds_note: Kinds this pack claims that the app's vocabulary does NOT have today (35 kinds, read 2026-11-20): structure.engineer_set, structure.column, structure.beam, structure.floor_framing, structure.wall_framing, structure.ceiling_framing, structure.roof_buildup. Claimed and in the app: structure.foundation, qa.run, export.pdf, export.render. Every other kind of the app is neither claimed nor deferred here: a contract of this process that carries one is a hard error, on purpose (rooms, casework, finishes play no part).
_acceptance_note: A phase names only checks that exist in the app today (read 2026-11-20): model.warnings_not_up, intake.doc_title_matches, final.pdf_exists, sheet.bounds_edge_clean. Everything else a phase needs is in CHECKS_WANTED.md and is run by hand, in numbers, until a checker exists.
_no_set_note: A Lite job has NO engineer's set (Mitch, blueprint-mitch 2026-11-21 20:48Z: "do youtink you are confident to frame an engineer lite set without goign off an engineered set? i feel liek you could. plus since lite isnt an actual engineered set we shoudlnt have to worry about sizing"). E1 is the frame basis from the designer's model, the house system and HOUSE_SIZES.md (typical sizes, not engineered). A work item of kind structure.engineer_set is deferred: built by nothing.
_product_note: The catalog SKU: the Shopify product "Framing Package — Lite". A preliminary framing model, framing plans, 3D pages and a material takeoff for a catalog plan, for reference and takeoff only. Not for construction; no sections, no details, no general notes, no engineer reconciliation.
_cost_note: Cost basis: target 120 to 200 dollars a run, tiered (Tony 2026-11-21 19:44Z). No run of this pack has been measured. Whaley ran the full pack on the judgment tier; the sheet phases are classed mechanical since then (automation/phase_classes.json).
